results.notes: Execution was proven clean (X3). The signal still failed at ideal fill, which is why no execution work is authorized to rescue it.
The 1h positive was carried by BTC and by June alone; remove-best-symbol and remove-best-day both break it.
Independent rediscovery is informative about the search process, not evidence about the mechanism.
G0 fails on execution-data coverage, not on the signal. This is the highest-priority open data gap.
The promising initial atlas number did not survive a fresh replay. Classic first-look artefact.
Positive mean with a zero median across few day clusters is the payoff-trap signature, not an edge.
The 208d history is a backward-looking carry accrual, not an out-of-sample result. Custody monitoring is an unbuilt precondition.
Rejected as alpha, retained permanently as anti-risk evidence.
A 100% NO_TRADE rate is a valid router result, not a broken router.

failure_routes.failure_mechanism: The signal is negative at ideal fill. Execution was independently proven clean, so no execution, latency, or depth work can rescue it.
failure_routes.notes: A genuinely new trigger can only be considered as a NEW family, not a variant of this one.

failure_routes.failure_mechanism: Out-of-sample and robustness failure: the positive result is carried by BTC and by a single month, and dies under remove-best-symbol and remove-best-day.
The 1h formulation is unstable across folds and died as a family. Re-testing 1h on the same data would be a cherry-picked revival.
failure_routes.notes: The successor is permitted only because it changes timeframe AND universe scope, carries a new model identity, and must confirm on post-failure data.

failure_routes.failure_mechanism: Signal-side robustness is the strongest of any non-FADE mechanism, but execution coverage is 4 usable order-book events, so the execution gate cannot be evaluated at all.
failure_routes.notes: Highest priority open route: the only mechanism whose blocker is purely data, not signal.

failure_routes.failure_mechanism: A promising first atlas did not survive a fresh replay: median and null checks both failed. The family is quarantined rather than closed because the initial event definition may be salvageable as a feature.
The payer is identifiable and non-discretionary, but 5m open-interest granularity hides the cascade inside the bar, so the event cannot be defined at decision time.
Every directional formulation tested negative and the completed 3-wallet sample was skewed all-short. The lane retains value only as suppression and regime intelligence.
Positive mean with a near-zero median over too few day clusters is a payoff-trap signature; the sample cannot separate edge from a handful of large winners.
Tagger v1 is noisy, event count is low, and future-dated published_at values were observed, so the causal timestamp cannot currently be trusted.
Not a signal failure: the carry is contractual, but forward funding softened below the 10-12% floor and the custody monitor that bounds the tail risk does not exist yet.
failure_routes.notes: Blocking gap is a field-level gap inside an existing source: funding publication timestamps must be confirmed present before A-1 causality holds.

failure_routes.failure_mechanism: High winrate with a catastrophic payoff ratio and 18 liquidations. The account style is a risk-of-ruin demonstration, and the low-leverage safe subset is N=19 and net negative.
15 of 116 variants were train-positive and none survived holdout, null, concentration, or neighbourhood attacks. The exercise consumed 116 trials on the shared historical data.
failure_routes.notes: Its lasting effect is on the trials ledger: any deflation computed on this data must inherit these 116 trials.

lineage_edges.structural_difference: Decision timeframe moves from 1h to 4h and the universe narrows from mixed majors to alts only, changing both the compression window and the liquidity tier the mechanism is claimed to operate in.
lineage_edges.justification: The parent is a closed rejected formulation, so the variant is admissible only with a recorded structural difference, a fresh frozen task id, and a new model identity. All three are present. Confirmation is still restricted to data generated after the 1h failure was recorded.
The non-AMEL factory rediscovered the same mechanism on the same data. Recording the duplication is what prevents it being counted as independent confirmation.
The family produced clean live execution and still lost, which is the observation that established the ideal-fill-before-execution ordering.
Directional use is closed. The lane survives only as a suppression input, which is a class change rather than a strategy variant.
The mechanism cannot be defined at decision time until the event stream is finer than the response horizon. It is a data request, not a hypothesis.

Retained deliberately as a refused edge: a proposed retry of a rejected family with no recorded structural difference, no new task id, and no new model identity. The builder must reject it, and the query CLI must never list it as a permitted variant.
